cases.name: Kenneth Arnold sighting
cases.supported_core: “Flying saucer” terminology emerged from reporting around Arnold’s description, shaping later perception and language.
cases.does_not_establish: Language can standardize morphology before evidence does.

cases.name: Roswell
cases.record_type: Military press, later investigations, testimony, disputed documents
cases.supported_core: A documented recovery of unusual balloon material became the center of crash-retrieval mythology.
cases.does_not_establish: Contemporaneous, official-later, witness, and forged layers must remain separate.

cases.name: Washington National Airport wave
cases.record_type: Radar, pilot, press, and official response
cases.supported_core: Multiple nights of radar and visual reports generated national attention and competing weather/radar explanations.
cases.does_not_establish: A case label can compress several tracks and nights.

cases.name: Hill encounter
cases.record_type: Witness history, hypnosis, later star-map analysis
cases.supported_core: The case became foundational to abduction and Zeta Reticuli lore.
cases.does_not_establish: Hypnotic recall and later analysis are not first-event data.

cases.name: Socorro / Lonnie Zamora
cases.supported_core: A law-enforcement witness reported an object and occupants; the case retains strong witness provenance but no confirmed origin.
cases.does_not_establish: Good witness provenance does not settle ontology.

cases.name: Westall
cases.supported_core: Many students and staff reported objects; surviving documentation is incomplete.
cases.does_not_establish: Long-term witness consistency and missing records are separate variables.

cases.name: Shag Harbour
cases.supported_core: Lights were reported descending toward water and a search followed.
cases.does_not_establish: Search activity does not establish recovered craft.

cases.name: Pascagoula
cases.record_type: Police report, covert recording, witness history
cases.supported_core: Two witnesses reported abduction and displayed distress in a covertly recorded private conversation.
cases.does_not_establish: Sincerity is not external attribution.

cases.name: Tehran
cases.supported_core: Iranian military aircrew reported an object and instrument effects.
cases.does_not_establish: Reported interference is not proof of deliberate alien jamming.

cases.name: Colares / Operação Prato
cases.record_type: Military archive, witness and medical narratives
cases.supported_core: Brazilian Air Force personnel investigated sustained local reports and documented testimony and imagery.
cases.does_not_establish: Investigation does not settle the cause of reported injuries.

cases.name: Wow! signal
cases.supported_core: A strong narrowband signal was recorded once and not confirmed as extraterrestrial.
cases.does_not_establish: Fame and signal shape do not replace repeatability.

cases.name: Rendlesham Forest
cases.supported_core: A contemporaneous military memorandum exists; later binary-code claims are separate.
cases.does_not_establish: Later memory-derived data cannot be backdated into the memo.

cases.name: Belgian wave
cases.record_type: Mass reports, police records, Air Force response
cases.supported_core: A large wave prompted official response; technical analysis can explain extreme F-16 radar maneuvers as artifacts.
cases.does_not_establish: Radar artifact resolution does not automatically resolve every visual report.

cases.name: Lazar / S-4 claims
cases.supported_core: Lazar publicly alleged work on recovered craft at S-4, adjacent to a real secret aerospace landscape.
cases.does_not_establish: Area 51’s reality does not authenticate S-4 claims.

cases.name: Ariel School
cases.supported_core: Many pupils reported unusual objects and figures; adult observation and physical evidence are limited.
cases.does_not_establish: Interview order, group influence, and later environmental-message framing matter.

cases.name: Varginha
cases.supported_core: Multiple reports became a creature-recovery narrative.
cases.does_not_establish: Retrospective testimony and ordinary military activity are not an authenticated body chain.

cases.name: Phoenix Lights
cases.record_type: Multiple observation groups and military activity
cases.supported_core: Reports from different times were grouped under one label; later lights are strongly associated with flares.
cases.does_not_establish: One explanation need not cover the entire evening.

cases.name: Nimitz / Tic Tac
cases.supported_core: A major modern multi-source UAP case with limited public raw data.
cases.does_not_establish: Multi-source does not mean every recollection describes one perfectly reconstructed track.

cases.name: Aguadilla
cases.record_type: Infrared sensor record and official analysis
cases.supported_core: AARO found no anomalous or transmedium behavior and offered a conventional interpretation.
cases.does_not_establish: Visual strangeness is not transmedium proof.

cases.name: Gimbal and GoFast
cases.supported_core: Authentic videos; GoFast analysis argues against anomalous speed.
cases.does_not_establish: Identity uncertainty and behavioral anomaly are separate.

cases.name: Oumuamua
cases.supported_core: The first confirmed interstellar object had unusual properties and generated natural and artificial hypotheses.
cases.does_not_establish: A published artificial hypothesis is not evidence of engineering.

cases.name: BLC1
cases.supported_core: A candidate signal was investigated and resolved as human-generated interference.
cases.does_not_establish: Candidate status is not a discovery announcement.

cases.name: USS Omaha-associated reports
cases.supported_core: Several records and clips are often grouped under one ship/event label.
cases.does_not_establish: Preserve each sensor, time, and claim separately.

cases.name: PWA192 pacing report
cases.record_type: FAA/ATC record and withheld radar context
cases.supported_core: A business-jet crew reported a pacing object; released material lacks a corresponding public radar solution and some files were withheld as security-sensitive.
cases.does_not_establish: Withholding and proximity to ranges do not establish exotic craft.

cases.name: 3I/ATLAS
cases.supported_core: The third known interstellar object shows cometary activity and no Earth threat.
cases.does_not_establish: Public speculation about technology is not positive evidence.

cases.name: Apophis close approach
cases.supported_core: Apophis will safely pass very close to Earth; impact risk is excluded for at least a century.
cases.does_not_establish: Doomsday and scheduled-reset claims contradict current orbit solutions.

cases.name: Atacama remains
cases.supported_core: The remains are human; alien claims caused ethical and provenance concerns.
cases.does_not_establish: Unusual anatomy is not nonhuman origin.

cases.name: Area 51 U-2/OXCART sightings
cases.supported_core: Secret high-altitude aircraft accounted for many reports and show how classified technology creates durable anomaly ecosystems.
cases.does_not_establish: Not every report near a secret site is explained by the acknowledged aircraft.
